name: Haunted Mansion: Experience
storyline: It was suddenly quiet inside the car. The smell of smoke came through the air vent. He looked up painfully, and all was blurry… He wasn’t sure of what was going on. His head and bones hurt badly, making it clear something serious had happened. Outside, a thick fog made it impossible to see far that night, but a tree right where the engine should be indicated he was quite in a tough spot in the middle of nowhere, where the search for help would lead him to a remote house. Strangely all looked familiar. Somehow this was not by chance. If only he would have known what was about to happen…
summary: A thrilling choice-based adventure. Drive the actions of the main character through a maze of suspense, adventure and survival decisions.
